scope: Oracle AArch64 namespace loopback, diagnostic single-round screening; not AX3000T/device results
limitations: C and R89 are exact-image/formal originals; source05/worker/head are diagnostic same-SDK Oracle builds, not canonical CI.
Server process CPU uses /proc stat including exited workers; do not substitute main-thread schedstat.
2ms observer samples thread births only as lower bound and imposes overhead varying with thread count.
No client/observer CPU included in daemon CPU.
CPU ticks quantize short samples; every actual tick count is reported.
Resource snapshots at before/after/1s/2s; no held200ms result from this run.
Same-machine pilot and four-round formal runs remain separate datasets.
Each side/gap has only one sample, in fixed C/R89/source05/worker/head order. No confidence interval or general performance claim.
800-request paced samples use 100 Hz CPU ticks: one tick is 12.5 us/request. Worker-vs-head differences are one tick.
Oracle host has normal background services. No other owned pressure/build task overlapped.
